messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — procurement just flagged the CoreCloud Azure marketplace deal. They blocked PO because the reseller ID on our PO is blank and the vendor portal requires a partner-reseller identifier before invoices can be accepted.
Owen Park: ugh, which field exactly? is this about the marketplace's secondary-reseller flow? :confused:
Maya Chen: Procurement says Azure Marketplace requires the 3-letter reseller_id (example: CCV). Our PO came from RevOps export and didn't include reseller mapping.
Anita Gomez: Also, finance is pushing back on Net45. Marketplace terms only allow Net30 or prepay for third-party offers — they want the contract amended.
Jake Patel: Do we have a signed MSA amendment for the reserved GPU capacity the customer requested? Procurement says no amendment = no vendor onboarding in portal.
Maya Chen: Not yet. Legal flagged a redline: need an explicit clause for "instance reservation" billing and cancellation windows. Legal Ops Bot — can you paste the suggested clause?
Legal Ops Bot: Suggested clause: "Provider will reserve dedicated capacity for Customer per the attached Order Form. Reservation cancellations less than 60 days prior to the reservation start date will incur a pro-rated fee equal to 50% of reserved capacity fees." See: <https://redwood.internal/clauses/instance-reservation|instance-reservation draft>
Grace Li (Vendor): From CoreCloud side — we can accept a reseller_id mapping if Redwood passes the partner alias to our onboarding flow. Also can accept Net45 for enterprise customers with a signed amendment referencing our marketplace settlement policy.
Owen Park: ok — action items:
- RevOps: include reseller_id mapping in PO export (Jake?)
- Legal: draft a one-page amendment with the reservation clause (Anita)
- Partnerships: coordinate vendor onboarding with CoreCloud (Maya)

Jake Patel: I'll change the export mapping — quick patch to payments ETL. Patch queued.
Anita Gomez: I'll drop a draft amendment in this thread in ~30m. Will try to keep it a one-pager.
Maya Chen: Thanks. If we can get a signed amendment + updated PO with reseller_id by EOD, procurement will unblock the marketplace publish and the customer can finish signup.
Grace Li (Vendor): I'll keep the onboarding ticket open and proactively attach the reseller mapping once you confirm.
Maya Chen: filing for escalation to Deal Desk if we miss EOD. tagging @here in Partnerships — please keep eyes on this. :eyes:
